name: 33043 · Big Pine Key, FL
findings: ZIP 33043 (Big Pine Key) has 14 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33043 (Big Pine Key) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33043 (Big Pine Key) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).
